title: othonna rigens
intro: Othonna rigens, commonly known as "Benguella", is a succulent plant species that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. The health benefits of Othonna rigens include its potential in treating fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant are primarily due to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. Othonna rigens contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
